title: Streaming Partner Month Taken from a Northgate+ Annual Refund
content:
**Rule.** On an immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the annual cancellation schedule, an amount for the bundled streaming subscription is taken from the refund as follows. One month's share of the fee is the fee divided by the paid term in months.

1. When the bundled streaming subscription was activated on or after the charge date of the fee being refunded, one month's share multiplied by 1.0 — a full month's share — is taken from the refund.
2. When it was last activated before that charge date but within the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date, one month's share multiplied by 0.5 — half a month's share — is taken from it.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken.

Activations are the streaming activations recorded among the membership's benefit uses; the latest of them is the one compared. "Within the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date" means fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from the activation date to the cancellation date. The amount is taken from the refund before the refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

| Latest streaming activation | Amount taken |
|---|---|
| on or after the charge date | one month's share |
| before the charge date, fewer than 12 whole calendar months before cancellation | half a month's share |
| 12 or more whole calendar months before cancellation, or none recorded | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration (fee 120.00 on a 12-month term).** One month's share is 10.00; an activation after the charge date takes 10.00 from the refund, an older activation inside the twelve months takes 5.00.
